description: Review a diff or a set of endpoints for API shape: list envelopes, route naming, validation at the HTTP boundary and bounded selector endpoints. Use before merging a change that adds or edits endpoints. Trigger on "review the API shape of this PR", "are my list endpoints consistent", or "check the routes in this controller". Not for auth, query cost or a general review; use the `review-auth`, `check-query-safety` or `review-changes` skill.
